d:
Presenting the latest video song "Sanwaar Loon" from movie "Lootera", the music is composed by much talented Amit Trivedi. The movie is set to release on 5th July 2013.
From the land of love, meet Varun and Pakhi in the greatest love story of 2013! Come fall in love with Love!
Song: Sawaar Loon
Singer: Monali Thakur
Music: Amit Trivedi
Lyrics: Amitabh Bhattacharya
Music On: T-Series
